claims.summary: En plural, accusative inanimate nouns match nominative plural and animate nouns match genitive plural.

locators.description: Cornell, “Acc. Sg. and Plur. endings and animacy,” lines 4–12: the plural rule for all declensions and the exact Я знаю этих профессоров / Я знаю эти рестораны pair.

claims.summary: In the attested phrase Я знаю эти рестораны, the inanimate object is accusative with nominative-shaped form; the paired animate form Я знаю этих профессоров is genitive-shaped.

sourceReferences.supports: En plural, accusative inanimate nouns match nominative plural and animate nouns match genitive plural. In the attested phrase Я знаю эти рестораны, the inanimate object is accusative with nominative-shaped form; the paired animate form Я знаю этих профессоров is genitive-shaped. Cornell’s grammar attests Я знаю эти рестораны and Я знаю этих профессоров as inanimate/animate plural accusative examples. The animacy-based syncretism applies to plural nouns of all declensions as specified in the source; lexical animacy can have exceptions.
